test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Aman travels 1200 km by train at 80 km/h, 1600 km by ship at 40 km/h, 1000 km by plane at 400 km/h, and 200 km by car at 50 km/h. What is the average speed for the entire distance? (rounded off to 2 decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Distance traveled by train = 1200 km

Speed of train = 80 km/h

Distance traveled by ship = 1600 km

Speed of ship = 40 km/h

Distance traveled by plane = 1000 km

Speed of plane = 400 km/h

Distance traveled by car = 200 km

Speed of car = 50 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance traveled / Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Total distance traveled = 1200 km + 1600 km + 1000 km + 200 km

Total distance traveled = 4000 km

Time taken by train = 1200 km / 80 km/h

Time taken by train = 15 hours

Time taken by ship = 1600 km / 40 km/h

Time taken by ship = 40 hours

Time taken by plane = 1000 km / 400 km/h

Time taken by plane = 2.5 hours

Time taken by car = 200 km / 50 km/h

Time taken by car = 4 hours

Total time taken = 15 hours + 40 hours + 2.5 hours + 4 hours

Total time taken = 61.5 hours

Average speed = Total distance traveled / Total time taken

⇒ Average speed = 4000 km / 61.5 hours

⇒ Average speed = 65.04 km/h

**The average speed for the entire distance is 65.04 km/h.**
